kb_candidates.statement: Theo tai lieu `known issues edge cases` Section: C2, doi status 1 invoice tu pending thang sang completed KHONG he goi bat ky API PayPal/ngan hang nao - he thong chi ghi nhan admin 'khai bao' da thanh toan va CHAP NHAN BINH THUONG viec doi status cho 1 invoice ma chua thuc su chuyen tien. Affiliate van nhan duoc email 'thanh toan hoan tat' du chua nhan tien thuc. KHONG co gi o tang code chan thao tac nham (quen chuyen tien ma doi status, hoac chuyen tien roi quen doi status). Day la hanh vi hien tai cua he thong (rui ro nam hoan toan o quy trinh con nguoi) - giu OBSERVED_CURRENT, KHONG duoc nang len CONFIRMED_EXPECTED.

doc_coverage_gaps.question: Ai duoc phep doi status invoice sang approved/completed, va co buoc duyet 2 nguoi (maker-checker) nao khong?
doc_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: Buoc approved duoc tai lieu mo ta la 'neu quy trinh noi bo yeu cau' - tuc quy uoc van hanh, khong phai hang rao he thong.

doc_coverage_gaps.question: fee cua invoice duoc tinh/luu the nao khi transfer_fee cua Payment Method de trong (Absorbed)?
doc_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: CLM-19-016 neu de trong = Ownego chiu phi, khong phai $0; nhung khong noi gia tri fee tren invoice khi do la gi.

doc_coverage_gaps.question: Sau khi snapshot tu dien khi chuyen sang completed, admin co sua tay duoc cac o payment_method_name/fee/payment_info truoc khi luu khong, va neu sua thi ban ghi luu gia tri nao?
doc_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: Tai lieu noi 'admin chi can xac nhan roi luu' - khong noi co chan sua hay khong.

doc_coverage_gaps.question: Co log/audit trail nao ghi lai viec admin doi status invoice sang completed (ai doi, luc nao) khong?
doc_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: C2 noi rui ro nam hoan toan o quy trinh con nguoi va khong co gi o tang code chan thao tac nham. Neu cung khong co audit trail thi khong co cach truy nguoc sai sot.
